turns.assessment: The equal ~5.13 dB reduction at the input and output of every amplifier on S03→S07 localizes the loss before the booster, rather than to an amplifier or fibre span. A contaminated OMS-input connector at S03 best explains a persistent common power reduction; unchanged pump currents and preserved, though degraded, signal argue against amplifier or hard failures.

proposals.rationale: The connector between the S03 ROADM degree and S03→S07 booster is upstream of amp0's input. Added loss there propagates nearly unchanged through all three amplifier input/output readings and causes the downstream channel-power and OSNR reductions.
